governance_requirements.summary: Freeze-map list changes require explicit Architecture Council approval.
Every freeze-map lane must record owner, phase, status bucket, validation gate, and rollback owner.
required_terms: owner, phase, status bucket, validation gate, and rollback owner

governance_requirements.summary: Freeze-in-C anchors stay blocked until a parity scorecard exists and the Architecture Council records why the status can change.
Ambiguous validation must keep the code in C with an explicit blocker.
required_terms: keep the code in C and record the blocker

gaps.why_now: The freeze-in-C anchors needed explicit governance text before future status changes could be reviewed honestly.
Phase 15 needed a lane-local note that records the bounded governance slice and its remaining scorecard follow-up.
The governance slice needed a dedicated Phase 15 build gate so freeze-map policy drift stays reviewable.
A convenience make target keeps the bounded parity scorecard and freeze-map governance checks easy to replay.
The parity scorecard follow-up is still the next bounded governance step before any freeze-in-C anchor can change status.
